verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents its own data-out paths: compliance reports with custom views and exports, plus API operations (companyCaptable, companyTransactions) that return a company's cap table and transaction rows in pages. Nothing shows a complete account-wide export, named open file formats, or an offboarding path. missing for 10: documented full-account data export covering all data (documents, grants, vesting, reports), explicit open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), an exit/offboarding procedure, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: One-click equity compliance reports, custom views and exports, make meeting compliance deadlines a breeze.
companyTransactions and companyCaptable can return a company's rows in pages, and only the rows that changed since an earlier request.
The operation user can retrieve cap table data about the queried company.
